title: c02 takes Q:field-chemoton: FCH vesicles with a membrane-retained autocatalyst that makes amphiphile
summary: Fork c03's fch-vesicles (vesicles from noise) and add a fed precursor P that crosses bilayers, a Gray-Scott-like autocatalyst K whose mobility the bilayer gates (min face mobility, exp(-beta (u-u_bg))), and production of amphiphile r K P with amphiphile degradation. Scratch tests on the Promislow-benchmark FCH: a bare K disk dies while K inside a vesicle persists, and the vesicle is maintained (r=0.02) or grows and meanders (r=0.06). Next: from noise, no-K and no-gate controls, and whether grown vesicles divide.
